previous_last_sync.summary: Human-reviewed manual recovery audit for configuration flash request serialization. Source evidence is pinned at [firmware/CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/CHANGELOG.md); no new user setting or workflow requires a guide. The ledger limits the integration merge to the audited original.

decisions.rationale: Serializes saves and reads and defers reentrant writes; it fixes internal storage coordination without exposing a new setting or workflow.
evidence: [firmware/CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/CHANGELOG.md): Configuration flash operations are serialized so concurrent saves and reads cannot overwrite each other.

[firmware/controllers/flash_main.cpp](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/controllers/flash_main.cpp): Atomic write claiming retains requests that arrive during active I/O and rejects overlapping reads.

[firmware/controllers/configuration_write_state.h](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/controllers/configuration_write_state.h): Explicit write/read ownership state tracks active, deferred and failed requests.

decisions.rationale: Preserves a verified configuration copy until erase, programming, byte, header and CRC checks pass; this is a reliability fix with no new tuning control.
evidence: [firmware/CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/CHANGELOG.md): Calibration burns verify erase, programmed bytes, header and CRC before replacing the remaining valid copy.

[firmware/controllers/configuration_storage.cpp](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/controllers/configuration_storage.cpp): Copy verification and bounded CRC reads gate replacement of the last verified copy.
